details: Oil prices surged to a three-week high after US President Donald Trump threatened "economic warfare and isolation on an unprecedented scale" against Iran, targeting nations providing financial support. Concerns over sustained disruptions to oil supplies through the Strait of Hormuz are keeping a geopolitical risk premium in the market.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Driving Oil Prices Higher

details: The US Treasury announced it will double its long-term bond buyback operations from $2 billion to at least $4 billion per operation, effective September 9. This move is designed to boost market liquidity, which has led to a drop in bond yields and a surge in risk assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP, alongside a significant wave of short liquidations.
title: US Treasury Bond Buybacks Boost Market Liquidity and Crypto

details: BlackRock, a major asset manager, discussed the intertwined roles of artificial intelligence (AI), geopolitical shifts, and asset tokenization in shaping future investment decisions for digital assets. The firm suggests that these forces will be crucial in driving the next phase of crypto markets, particularly for foundational assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum.
title: BlackRock Highlights AI, Geopolitics, and Tokenization as Key Crypto Drivers
